items.reason: Describes the same updateEvent fallback that compares destination externalId against a falsy externalCalendarId, losing the configured calendar.
Describes the same faulty deleteEvent fallback predicate, which fails to select the configured destination when externalCalendarId is absent.
Describes the unguarded integration access on an undefined mainHostDestinationCalendar, crashing the Google Meet fallback.
Describes null initialization causing the optional push to discard secondary hosts' destination calendars.
Describes the same missing optional chaining on mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration when no destination calendar exists.
Describes the same falsy externalCalendarId comparison that breaks destination fallback in updateEvent and deleteEvent.
Describes the same undefined destination dereference that crashes Google Meet bookings instead of falling back to Cal Video.
Describes the same TypeError from accessing mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration without optional chaining.
Describes the same unguarded integration access after destructuring a null or empty destination calendar array.
Describes the same nullable destination calendar reaching an unguarded integration access and breaking the Cal Video fallback.
Describes Office365 createEvent ignoring the supplied credentialId and selecting the first host's destination for every collective host.
